summary: [spec fidelity] Latest-only `canon query` of the folded kinds (subject, finding, scenario, change) now sorts by `at` instead of the natural key, so on canon's own repo the order changes far beyond records sharing an `at`. Reproduced: 0.29.0 (built from 6f438b9a) on 927f80d3 vs this binary on the re-migrated tree: `query --kind subject --all` starts authoring-scaffold, context-capability, dispatch-manifest... in 0.29 and format-corpus, ingest-pipelines, vocab-typed... now; `--kind finding` starts canon-0-13-1-codex-skills_1_1 vs s42-close-the-open-loops_8_1; the `at` sequences differ (review and evidence keep the same `at` sequence, so their differences are ties only). Brief F4 acceptance and ledger.migrate.06's Then allow only names, the kind name and the order of records sharing an `at` to differ; test 06b compares counts only, and b42cf3d7's 'query records equal for every kind' holds as sets, not as output. Conformance query-subject-json/1.out and subject-adopt-second-subject/7.out were regenerated to the new order. Fix: order the folded output by the typed components (numbers as numbers) then `at` then digest, which is body-field order and reproduces 0.29's zero-padded key order; or the human amends F4 to accept the `at` order. Blast radius: every agent or script that pages `query --kind finding|subject` sees a different first page.
